interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Installing street lamps would enhance visibility and safety for all road users during evening hours.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk clear zone
interventions.description: Ensure a consistent clear width on the sidewalk by relocating or consolidating utility poles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate large utility bins to a designated furniture zone or off-street location to maintain clear walking width.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.
